title: Avramov-type regularity: a perfect map into a target over a local complete intersection base forces both maps to be complete intersections

standard_prerequisites.use: Equivalence of regular and Koszul-regular sequences in Noetherian rings (More on Algebra, lemma-noetherian-finite-all-equivalent), localization of regularity for ideals (Algebra, lemma-regular-sequence-in-neighbourhood; Divisors, lemma-Noetherian-scheme-regular-ideal), and the divided-powers criterion for perfect maps between regular immersions (Divided Power Algebra, lemma-perfect-map-ci).

core_obligations: Set up the affine-local picture with nested regular immersions into affine spaces.
Identify J regular from the lci hypothesis and finite tor dimension from perfectness.
Apply the DPA criterion to split regularity between I and J/I and globalize.

proof_roadmap.step: Translate to Noetherian local rings with two ideal sequences.
Invoke lemma-perfect-map-ci for the regular-sequence conclusion.

difficulty_reason: Given a commutative diagram of schemes over a locally Noetherian base S, with Y -> S locally of finite type, f : X -> Y perfect, and X -> S a local complete intersection morphism, the lemma concludes X -> Y is a local complete intersection morphism and Y -> S is Koszul at every image point of X. The retained proof works entirely in the Noetherian world where regular and Koszul-regular sequences agree; after affine localization it chooses nested closed immersions into affine spaces over S, reads off the kernels J of O_{A^{n+m}_S, x} -> O_{X,x} and I of O_{A^n_S, f(x)} -> O_{Y,f(x)}, notes J is generated by a regular sequence (X -> S is lci) and O_{X,x} has finite tor dimension over O_{Y,f(x)} (f perfect), and applies the divided powers algebra lemma that a perfect map whose ambient ideal is generated by a regular sequence forces both I and J/I to be generated by regular sequences (Divided Power Algebra, lemma-perfect-map-ci). Retained author proof at lines 18376-18418.

dedup.scope: Implication lci + perfect factorization yields lci factor and Koszul base map.
